name: common
description: Common utilities (enabled by default): token-lens — read-only Codex usage timelines, compaction accounting, and evidence-based skill experiment diagnosis; better-prompts — optimize prompts: audit, rewrite, draft, or migrate system prompts, agent instructions, tool descriptions, and CLAUDE.md files against official Claude and GPT-5.x prompting guidance (outcome-first structure, stopping conditions, autonomy boundaries, lean-prompt diet); delegate — goal-oriented delegation of bounded execution slices to native sub-agents, Codex CLI, or Claude CLI (worth-it gate, live model-catalog lookup, supervised long-task patrols, native-first Luna Max with exact-profile CLI fallback, evidence-based acceptance); define-goal — turn a fuzzy intention into a concrete, measurable goal with explicit validators and scope bounds before work starts; strategic-advance — keep an already-locked objective moving through long-running, cross-tool execution with one main effort, evidence-backed moves, a stateless campaign scribe that owns state bookkeeping and re-probes gating evidence, context protection, dynamic reassessment, and conditional human takeover; wait-what — stop and re-pitch the last explanation in plain Traditional Chinese by default, or another explicitly requested language, when the user didn't follow, pitched for a complete newcomer (brief background, analogies, light storytelling) with a visuals-first HTML companion under .claude/wait-what/ when tooling allows; wayfinder — chart an effort too big for one session as a local-markdown map of decision tickets (blocking, frontier, fog of war) with an interactive HTML map view, resolved one ticket per session, backed by companion skills grilling, domain-modeling, research, and prototype, with an operator posture (the lead session judges and intervenes while execution slices route through delegate) and a drain mode that auto-resolves AFK tickets in parallel and stops hard at the human-decision boundary, plus optional routing to the baransu suite (think/read/learn/design/contract/seal/hunt/review/ship) when installed. User-facing prose defaults to Traditional Chinese unless another language is explicitly requested. Enabled by default; disable with `claude plugin disable common` if unwanted.
